findings.issue: `public import TauCeti.Analysis.Semigroups.Dissipative.Basic` is unused after this diff: the file no longer mentions `IsDissipative`/`IsMDissipative` anywhere. It survives only because `Dissipative.Basic` publicly re-exports the resolvent API, so every downstream consumer (`HilleYosida/Approximation.lean`, the new `Convergence.lean`) now publicly depends on the dissipativity theory for nothing.
